name: How long does a full kitchen renovation typically take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen renovation typically take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full kitchen renovation varies based on the scope and complexity of the project, as well as the lead times for custom materials. While minor updates might be completed in a few weeks, a comprehensive renovation that involves significant layout changes, custom cabinetry, and structural modifications can take several months from initial design to final installation. AKN Design Group provides a transparent project timeline upfront, detailing each phase from design approval and permit coordination to construction and final walkthrough. Understanding these timelines early in the process helps manage expectations and ensures a smooth project flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration for a full kitchen renovation varies based on scope and custom materials, typically ranging from several weeks to a few months. AKN provides a transparent timeline upfront.
